d:
A mishmash of quasi-chronological backups for Hypno artist Sleepymaid, MOSTLY sourced via gallery-DL.

This has been a common request over the years, but represents something of an annoyance too, as Sleepymaid's really not as gone as you'd think; their site's been down every time I've checked for over half a decade now, but a guy archived most of it circa 2018 in https://e-hentai.org/g/1260452/2331ed3727/, and while their twitter's abandoned it's intact and un-nuked - as is their actively used bsky.
Meanwhile, while rumblings exist of hypnohub nukings, I've been livescraping them ever since 2022, and find their deletion rate not even at 10%; just comparing their live hypnohub tag count at the time of this posting (892 images) to my backup of the same (941) shows that while moderation's likely happening, it's in no way as dire as most folks seem to believe.

Either way, I'm throwing what I have up in here - as I see people in the 2018 gallery clamoring for something more up-to-date, and I suppose I can somewhat provide - but since so much of Sleepymaid's output's otherwise through singleton private commissions, or otherwise surreptitiously distributed, there's not really a good way to represent /everything/ of theirs, nor any great need for site backups of public pages (since for the most part, they still exist). If you have other sources, PM them to me and I'll throw 'em in, but for the most part I've never been too concerned about 100%ing this one.

As for content: everything's been antidupl'd out to find the best version of each image; I chose to prioritize the hypnohub uploads BENEATH those in the 2018 panda gallery - as they're generally lower quality across the board - but since that panda gallery wasn't scraped live by me, I can't confirm if its chunk is properly chronologically ordered or not.

Also note that two gifs - HHub_55177_73bcfa64a962a3f448b3523ebbd4b4e7_sleepymaid.gif and HHub_99396_38b3e62b43352bd880d78059c81ac277_sleepymaid.gif - didn't make it in here, due to overlarge filesizes. They're both available live on Hhub though, so whatever. I'm not reencoding the fuckers.

Note that I've also scraped thousands of other art accounts, for every eyecatching Transformation and TF-Adjacent (IE Hypno, Trait Change...) specialist I can find - so if someone you liked got nuked at any point post-2022, check https://zerobin.net/?9e1b4632b2a0edb0#g+Z0HZUY39NU8rWIighbyGhdsCBKgHJT0zBhlo71QwM= (or the more up to date 'interests' section of my forum profile) for an availability list, give me a DM if you see something what's been lost, and I'll see about throwing them in a gallery too.

I do also have raw .json files for every most every file I've scraped, so if you're the sort to want post metadata as well, give me a ping and I'll hook you up there too.
